_meta.title: H3 PDD 8-Step (Alibaba PAI Acc adapter) - single-pass FL2VA/T2V + audio
_meta.status: NEW / experimental - does not touch any existing workflow
_meta.what: MiniMax H3 accelerated with Alibaba PAI's PDD (Phased Distribution Distillation) 8-step 'Acc' adapter instead of the lightx2v turbo LoRA. PDD's 32 trained time intervals are fused 4-at-a-time into 8 joint audio+video model forwards. The MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced node emits the MODEL, SAMPLER and SIGMAS as one bundle on a fixed contract (euler / simple / 8 NFE / video shift 12 / audio shift 3 / CFG 1, adapter strength 1.0) - so there is no SigmaShift, KSamplerSelect or BasicScheduler node in this graph, and NO other LoRA may be stacked.
requires: 1) ENABLE the T8 node pack: rename  custom_nodes/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8.disabled  ->  custom_nodes/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8  and restart ComfyUI. (It was parked as .disabled on 2026-09-01 as a large, less-vetted ~200-file pack - see workflows/h3_allinone_2stage_latentupscale.md. Only the PDD setup node is needed here.)

2) DOWNLOAD the PDD adapter into models/loras/ :  MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-Acc-8Step_comfyui_pdd.safetensors  (Ref2VA variant: MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-Acc-8Step_comfyui_pdd.safetensors). Source: Alibaba PAI / the T8 pack's model list.

3) DOWNLOAD the FULL non-pruned base into models/diffusion_models/ :  minimax_h3_fl2va_int8_convrot.safetensors . The pruned convrot file this box already has (minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) will NOT satisfy the PDD adapter - it expects the 258-block backbone + 4 dynamic output heads + AdaLN width 2688 of the full build.
_meta.vs_current_pipeline: The v22 CCTV pipeline uses AIStudioH3MultiShotRender's core recipe (turbo LoRA @1.0 + realism LoRA @0.9, 8 steps euler/simple, sigma_shift 6/3). This is the same 8-step budget but via a purpose-trained distillation schedule rather than a naive BasicScheduler(8) over a 4-step turbo LoRA - it is the 'proper PDD-aware split' referenced in h3_allinone_2stage_latentupscale.md as the fix for that path's checkerboard corruption. Expect different motion/skin character; A/B against v22.
_meta.t2v_vs_fl2v: As wired = FL2V (node 11 LoadImage -> node 12 resize -> node 20 first_frame). Pure T2V: delete the link into node 20 first_frame, or set nodes 11+12 to Bypass. First+last frame: add a second LoadImage+ImageResizeKJv2 into node 20 last_frame.
_meta.knobs: node 20 prompt ; node 20 + node 12 width/height (keep matched) ; node 20 length (17k+5 grid) ; node 8 widget 3 = adapter strength (official 1.0 - do not change without a separately trained contract). Start small: 736x416 x124 serial on 16 GB. Steps/scheduler/shift are locked by the PDD node - do not add nodes to override them.
_meta.verify_after_enabling_pack: node 8's three widget input keys (adapter_name / variant / strength) are inferred from the pack's own tools/build_pdd_workflows.py (frontend widgets_values = [filename, variant, 1.0]). After enabling the T8 pack, open http://127.0.0.1:8188/object_info and confirm the exact required-input key names for MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced; rename here if they differ.
_meta.format: API-format graph. Drag onto the ComfyUI canvas (0.31.0 offers to import) or Workflow > Open.

inputs.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: Cinematic live-action, slow push-in, dim interior. The same adult woman from the first frame sits at a wooden table by a rain-streaked window, warm lamplight on one side of her face. At 00:02 she turns her head a few degrees toward the window and blinks once. At 00:04 she lifts a cup with both hands and holds it near her chin, steam rising. The camera pushes in very slowly and stops. She says clearly, once: What time did you say the last train leaves? overall_soundscape: steady rain on the glass, a low room-tone hum, the small ceramic click of the cup on the saucer, distant muffled street noise. non_diegetic_music: a sparse warm piano figure, a few notes, soft felt tone, no percussion, holding under the line.
